question: What form of the goddess should be visualized in meditation with this mantra?
premises: Meditation on the goddess is prescribed.
The goddess is described as nine-essenced and deer-eyed.
She is characterized as granting the bliss of brahman.
inference: One should meditate on the deer-eyed, nine-essenced goddess who grants brahman-bliss.
uncertainties: navarasāṃ may refer to nine aesthetic sentiments or nine essences
plain_english: One should meditate on the deer-eyed goddess, endowed with the nine rasas, who grants the bliss of Brahman.
